name: Give
description: Accept donations via Stripe, cheque or bank transfer.
project_description:
This module gives potential donors a couple easy ways to give to an organization or person:

 
 By credit card with Stripe (2.9% + 30 cents a transaction) 
 ( coming !) By bank transfer (low transaction fees) 
 By pledging to pay by check 
 
 Features 
 
 Create donation forms within your Drupal site 
 Automatically send thank you emails to donors 
 Set recurring donation options 
 Donation reports 
 Integration with the Paragraphs module 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Give creation form. 
 
 
 
 Give donation form. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Administrative report page listing donations. 
 
 
 
 Administrative report of a donation.
